home.tagline: Ask your questions about public transport, in plain language.
home.intro.before: Timetables, journeys, lines, shared bikes and scooters: an assistant queries
home.intro.after: for you, a service that gathers the open data of transport networks worldwide, real time included. The answers come with interactive views: maps, departure boards, detailed journeys.
home.example.journey: “How to go from Paris Gare de Lyon to Avignon TGV?”
home.example.reachable: “Where can I go in 30 minutes from Bellecour?”
home.step1.after: by clicking the “{button}” button. The account is free, and it provides the AI model that answers.
home.step2: Keep the free model selected by default, or choose another one. Free models have a limited number of requests per day, plenty for occasional use.
home.step3: Ask your question. Share your location if you want “near me” answers.
home.privacy: Your key stays in this browser tab and is only sent to OpenRouter. No account is created on this site.
home.screenshotAlt: Example answer: a Paris to Frankfurt journey, with the list of connections, the map and the detailed itinerary.
home.attribution.after: . Their licences and attribution conditions apply.
